latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release introducing the source-incorporator skill for research writing.

- Integrates a decision tree to choose between quoting, paraphrasing, or summarizing source material.
- Provides three methods for smoothly integrating quotations into prose.
- Offers guidance on adding framing sentences to clarify the relevance of evidence.
- Includes a five-point checklist to audit drafts for inadvertent plagiarism.
- Supports selection and verification of citation style for in-text references.
- Targeted at anyone writing evidence-based documents—students, researchers, academics, and professionals.
